Yes, this level of control is exactly right — it's the "only if I choose it" refresh I was hoping for. My saved details sit on one side, the newer page details on the other, and crucially nothing is ticked to begin with, so opening this comparison changes nothing on its own. The little "Nothing changes until you choose what to replace" line says that reassurance out loud, which I appreciate.

And being able to pick field by field is better than I even expected. I might want the page's newer picture but keep my own hand-written title and description — this lets me take just the one and leave the rest. Then "Keep everything" is a clean way to back out having changed nothing, and "Apply selected updates" only touches the boxes I actually ticked.

So my edits are never at risk unless I deliberately hand a field over. That's the safe, on-purpose behavior I wanted. This is good.
